name: Fusion cable-in-conduit critical-current characterization at 4.5 K and 10.8 T
plain_name: Fusion cable-in-conduit critical-current characterization at 4.5 K and 10.8 T
description: Apply transport current to a helium-cooled superconducting conductor in SULTAN's background field and measure onset of resistive voltage.

sources.citation: EPFL Swiss Plasma Center, SULTAN Test Facility

requirements.rationale: SULTAN's documented lower operating point is 4.5 K.
The selected boundary test requests the documented 10.8 T field.
A conductor transformer/current circuit and voltage-tap measurement are required.

missing_information: Requested sample current, helium mass flow/pressure, field uniform region, joint layout and electrothermal stability require confirmation; the catalog does not assert independent maxima coexist for every sample.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
